story.iWant: to record cash/bank receipts and post them to the general ledger
story.soThat: inflows are accurately captured, traceable, and easily reconciled

tasks.task: Validate Existing AR Receipt Domain Alignment - Review existing /api/v1/ar/receipts endpoints, identify gaps, update validations
Cash/Bank Account Integration - Ensure receipt payloads accept cashAccountId/bankAccountId, use glAccountCode for posting
AR Allocation Rules - Implement allocation logic with no over-collection, recompute remaining balances
Reversal Workflow - Implement reversing receipt/voucher creation with mandatory reason and cross-links
Batch Import Implementation - CSV/Excel template with atomic import and detailed error reporting
Attachments Handling - Integrate with secure storage, type/size validation (10 files, 20MB total)
RBAC and Threshold Enforcement - Role-based rules for create/post/reverse/import/download
Frontend – Receipt Form and List UX - All required fields, bank account picker, AR allocation UI
Frontend – Import and Attachments UX - Import file upload with progress, multi-file attachment UI
Testing – Backend - Unit tests, integration tests, performance tests
Testing – Frontend and E2E - Component tests, Playwright E2E, regression tests

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Receipt Form Fields - Captures date, auto-number (CR-YYYY-seq), payer (customer/other), reference, amount (>0), cash/bank account (active), payment method, attachment(s). Validated client- and server-side.
AR Allocation to Invoices - Shows open invoices with remaining balances, supports partial allocations, prevents over-collection, displays before/after remaining amounts.
Validation Rules - Posting blocked if period closed, account inactive, amount ≤0, or required dimensions missing. Descriptive error responses.
Correct GL Posting Logic - Creates vouchers: Dr Cash/Bank (1111/1121 via account.glAccountCode), Cr AR (131) or Other Income (711). Rounding matches GL engine.
Reversal Workflow - Creates linked reversing voucher/receipt, cross-linked, marked as reversed, mandatory reversal reason captured and audit-logged.
Batch Import of Receipts - CSV/Excel import with header templates, atomic processing, partial allocations, detailed error reporting with row/field.
Performance Telemetry - Create+post simple receipt ≤10 seconds, latency logged for observability.
Attachment Handling - Up to 10 files, ≤20MB total, images/PDFs preview, blocked file types rejected with clear messages.
RBAC and Thresholds - Accountants create/post up to threshold, over-threshold follows maker-checker, server-side enforcement.
Audit Trail - All create/edit/post/reverse/import/download actions generate audit entries with payload diffs and event hashes.

constraints.constraint: Reuse existing ARPayment entity and /api/v1/ar/receipts endpoints - do not create new receipt tables or controllers.
GL posting must use bankAccount.glAccountCode for Dr entries, not hardcoded account codes.
All posting/reversal through VoucherService to maintain double-entry invariant (NFR11) and period close constraints.
Follow standard API response wrapper: { data, meta, error } format.
Company-scoped via CompanyContext and CompanyScopedEntity patterns - all queries filtered by company_id.
RBAC: Accountant+ can create/post, Chief Accountant+ for reversals, enforced server-side via @PreAuthorize.
Audit all mutations with before/after diffs, actor metadata, IP capture, HMAC-SHA256 hashing.
Period must be open for posting - enforced via voucher engine.
Bank account must be active and have valid glAccountCode to accept receipts.
Receipt amount must be positive; allocations cannot exceed invoice remaining balance.
Follow existing test patterns: ReceiptServiceImplTest for unit, ReceiptControllerIntegrationTest for API.

interfaces.interface: Create draft receipt: { receiptDate, customerId, bankAccountId/cashAccountId, amount, reference, paymentMethod, isStandalone, allocations }
Post receipt to GL - creates voucher Dr Cash/Bank, Cr AR 131 or Other Income 711. Requires DRAFT status.
Reverse posted receipt - creates linked reversal receipt/voucher. Requires { reason } in body.
Get open invoices for customer with remaining balances for allocation picker.
Batch import receipts from CSV/Excel with atomic processing.
List active cash/bank accounts for picker. Query: type=CASH|BANK, status=active|inactive.
Internal method creating voucher entries and updating invoice statuses after posting.
Internal method creating reversal receipt/voucher with cross-linking and audit logging.

tests.standards: Backend: JUnit 5 + Mockito for unit tests, TestContainers + Spring Boot Test for integration. Frontend: Vitest + Testing Library for component tests, Playwright for E2E. Coverage reporting configured for both stacks. Follow existing test class patterns in backend/src/test/java/com/accounting/service/impl/sales/.

ideas.idea: Test receipt form validation: required fields, amount positive, account active check
Test allocation logic: partial allocation, over-collection prevention, remaining balance update
Test posting blocked: closed period, inactive account, amount ≤0, missing customer for 131 credit
Test GL posting: correct Dr/Cr accounts based on glAccountCode, standalone vs allocated receipts
Test reversal workflow: creates reversal receipt, cross-links, reason required (min 10 chars), audit logged
Test batch import: valid CSV, invalid rows with error details, atomic rollback on failure
Test performance: measure post latency, assert ≤10 seconds for simple receipt
Test attachments: file count/size limits, blocked file types, preview generation
Test RBAC: accountant can post, chief accountant for reversal, unauthorized access denied
Test audit trail: verify audit entries on create/post/reverse with correct diffs
